name: safewindow-rules-tests
description: Tests of firestore.rules on the local Firestore emulator. No Firebase login and no network to Firebase needed.

scripts.test: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.36.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-safewindow --config ../../firebase.json "node --test rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.36.0 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-safewindow --config ../../firebase.json "node e2e.mjs"
